description: Apply a diff file to an original.

option.name: --backup
tip: Back up the original contents of each file.

option.name: --backup-if-mismatch
tip: Back up a file if the patch does not match exactly and backups are not otherwise requested.

option.name: --basename-prefix
tip: Prepend PREFIX to backup file basenames.

option.name: --batch
tip: Ask no questions; skip bad-Prereq patches; assume reversed.

option.name: --binary
tip: Read and write data in binary mode.

option.name: --context
tip: Interpret the patch as a context difference.

option.name: --directory
tip: Change the working directory to DIR first.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: Do not actually change any files; just print what would happen.

option.name: --ed
tip: Interpret the patch as an ed script.

option.name: --follow-symlinks
tip: Follow symbolic links when looking for input files.

option.name: --force
tip: Like --batch, but ignore bad-Prereq patches and assume unreversed.

option.name: --forward
tip: Ignore patches that appear to be reversed or already applied.

option.name: --fuzz
tip: Set the fuzz factor to LINES for inexact matching.

option.name: --get
tip: Get files from RCS etc. if positive; ask if negative.

option.name: --help
tip: Output this help.

option.name: --ifdef
tip: Make merged if-then-else output using NAME.

option.name: --ignore-whitespace
tip: Ignore white space changes between patch and input.

option.name: --input
tip: Read the patch from PATCHFILE instead of standard input.

option.name: --merge
tip: Merge using conflict markers instead of creating reject files.
STYLE is merge or diff3; the value must be attached with =.

option.name: --no-backup-if-mismatch
tip: Do not back up a file if the patch does not match exactly and backups are not otherwise requested.

option.name: --normal
tip: Interpret the patch as a normal difference.

option.name: --output
tip: Output patched files to FILE.

option.name: --posix
tip: Conform to the POSIX standard.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Prepend PREFIX to backup file names.

option.name: --quoting-style
tip: Output file names using quoting style WORD.
Possible values: literal, shell, shell-always, c, escape.
The default is taken from the QUOTING_STYLE environment variable, or shell if unset.

option.name: --read-only
tip: How to handle read-only input files.
Possible values: ignore, warn, fail.
warn is the default.

option.name: --reject-file
tip: Output rejects to FILE.

option.name: --reject-format
tip: Create context or unified rejects.
Possible values: context, unified.

option.name: --remove-empty-files
tip: Remove output files that are empty after patching.

option.name: --reverse
tip: Assume patches were created with old and new files swapped.

option.name: --set-time
tip: Set the times of patched files, assuming local time.

option.name: --set-utc
tip: Set the times of patched files, assuming diff uses UTC (GMT).

option.name: --silent
tip: Work silently unless an error occurs.

option.name: --strip
tip: Strip NUM leading components from file names.

option.name: --suffix
tip: Append SUFFIX to backup file names.

option.name: --unified
tip: Interpret the patch as a unified difference.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Output extra information about the work being done.

option.name: --version
tip: Output version information and exit.

option.name: --version-control
tip: Use STYLE version control.
Possible values: simple, numbered, existing.
